caption: The drawing depicts a single tall, cylindrical drinking mug positioned upright at the center of the composition. The mug is brown in color and has a single handle attached to its right side, curving outward and back toward the body of the mug. The mug sits on a flat, green surface, depicted with texture and shading. In the lower left corner of the green surface, there are two wheat stalks lying down, light brown and yellowish in color, with long, thin awns extending outwards. The background of the image is plain and off-white. At the top of the drawing, there is text in uppercase letters that reads, "TALL DRINKING MUG EARLY 19th CENTURY."
title: Tall Drinking Mug
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
